title: Motor start stop latch
prompt: Implement a motor latch. Initially Motor=FALSE. StopBtn or EStop stops in the same scan, with priority over StartBtn. Otherwise StartBtn starts; releasing StartBtn retains Motor.
scan_semantics: Inputs sampled before scan; outputs checked after same scan. Variables persist between scans. Each test starts at declarations initial values. Unspecified inputs retain their last value. Timer first enabling scan ET=0.

provenance.synthesis_process: Authored from a named industrial control scenario; fixed interface, priority, scan convention, boundary tests and LTL obligations were designed together.
provenance.adaptations: Resolve inconsistent timing row by explicitly selecting same-scan after-execution observation. Add latch, simultaneous stop/start and emergency reset tests.
provenance.rationale: Motor start stop latch is a common PLC control pattern; explicit limits make the task testable.
provenance.review_process: Automated schema, reference-fixture scan tests and finite-trace LTL consistency checks. Human PLC scenario/spec review is still required.
provenance.source_document: Final project_ENGLISH.docx, section V motor example
